name: calendar
description: A date and range selection control built from composable calendar-day, calendar-month, preset, and calendar component sets.

trigger.clockIcon: color/icon/default — h-4 w-4, trailing position, tabIndex=-1
trigger.openStateTrigger: JS conditional (open && '...') — not CSS data-attribute. Popover.Trigger wraps only the Clock button, not the whole container.

popover.animation: data-[state=open]: fade-in-0 + zoom-in-95 | data-[state=closed]: fade-out-0 + zoom-out-95
popover.focusBehavior: onOpenAutoFocus preventDefault — focus stays on text input, not first column item

columnContainer.scrollbar: hidden — scrollbar-none class + scrollbarWidth:none inline style
columnContainer.autoScroll: on mount and on selected change: querySelector [data-selected=true] → scrollIntoView block:center behavior:instant
columnContainer.gap: gap-0.5 (2px — spacing/component/xxs between items within each column)

columnSeparator.alignment: flex items-center h-48 pt-7 — vertically offset to align with items, not label

timePicker.structure: CalendarWithTime > [Calendar] + [border-t section > Time label + [Popover > trigger + Popover.Content(p-0.5, radius/lg) > flex row gap-0.5 > [HH col] + [:] + [MM col]]]

behavior.typingSync: Input change → regex /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/ match → hours clamped to 0-23 padded 2 digits, minutes snapped to nearest 5-minute value in MINUTES array
behavior.columnHourSelect: sets hours + rebuilds inputVal as HH:minutes — popover stays open
behavior.columnMinuteSelect: sets minutes + rebuilds inputVal as hours:MM — popover stays open
behavior.popoverToggle: Clock button (Popover.Trigger) toggles open. Text input does NOT open popover on focus — only Clock button does
behavior.closeOnOutsideClick: Radix Popover default — clicking outside the popover closes it
behavior.persistsOnClose: selected hours/minutes preserved between open/close — reopening shows previous selection scrolled to center
behavior.dateTimeIndependence: date selection (calendar) and time selection are independent — neither resets the other

dateTime: footer: Time label + combobox-trigger (Type=Time-picker, State=Default) which opens menu-dropdown Type=os-time-menu
composition.monthYearSelector: view state swap — days | months | years. Month button and year button always visible in header. Months view: 4×3 pill grid. Years view: 4×3 pill grid (12-year range). Prev/next arrows navigate month/year/12-years depending on active view.
composition.timePicker: custom popover — not native OS time input. Two modes: type HH:MM directly, or click Clock icon to open HH/MM scrollable columns. Bidirectional sync: typing updates columns, selecting from columns updates input. Minutes in 5-min increments.

accessibility.grid: role=grid on weeks area, row per week, gridcell per day.

constraints: Use Default for single date selection.
Use Range for start/end date pairs.
Use Month-Year Selector only as a drill-down view.
Do not override calendar-day fills from parent calendar.

useCases: Booking or reservation flow where the full month must be visible and unavailable dates are marked
Dashboard analytics filter where the user picks a date range inline on the page
Leave or absence request form with a start and end date
Event scheduler that needs quick preset options ('Next 7 days', 'This month') alongside a custom picker
Appointment booking widget that combines a date and time in one step
Report or audit log page where the always-visible calendar is the primary navigation control

Default.whenToUse: Single-date selection embedded in a page or panel
examples: Task due date in a sidebar

Range.whenToUse: Start + end date pair across two visible months

Month-Year Selector.whenToUse: Drill-down navigation — triggered by tapping the month label in any calendar header
examples: Jump to a distant month in a booking flow

Presets.whenToUse: Power users need fast shortcuts alongside the ability to pick a custom range

Date-Time Picker.whenToUse: Both a date and a time are required in one combined control

Booked Dates.whenToUse: Specific days must be marked unavailable; week rows need programmatic control

comparedTo.situation: Always-visible date panel embedded in a page layout
Date input that pops a calendar on demand (form field + trigger button)
Multi-date or range selection displayed inline
User needs quick preset shortcuts alongside a custom range

notes: Status is based on Calendar.md only. Calendar.md does not mark this component stale or not ready.

changelog.change: Month/year selector: 3 views (days|months|years), separate June/2026 buttons. Time picker: custom HH:MM popover with scrollable columns, trailing Clock icon, bidirectional text+picker sync. Row spacing: [&_tbody_tr+tr]:mt-0.5. Outside day selected foreground: aria-selected:opacity-100 + brand/primary/foreground.

Date-Time Picker footer updated: input-field instance replaced with combobox-trigger Type=Time-picker instance. Time picker now uses menu-dropdown Type=os-time-menu (HH/MM scrollable columns) instead of a standalone input.

Time picker popover corrected to match Figma + system standard: radius radius/md→radius/lg, padding p-2→p-0.5 (2px), column gap gap-2→gap-0.5 (2px). Figma os-time-menu is the source of truth. Also fixed: column item width 40px→48px (w-12), gap between items 0→gap-0.5 (2px).

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.

notes: Month/year selector: custom CaptionWithToggle replaces DayPicker default nav. View state: days|months|years.
Multi-month (Range): uses DayPicker built-in caption, no custom wrapper.
Time picker: custom Radix Popover with two TimeColumn scrollable lists.
Row spacing: [&_tbody_tr+tr]:mt-0.5 on table — mt-* doesn't work on <tr> without display:flex.
